Mixture-of-experts models activate only a small subset of experts per token, so most experts can sit idle in RAM without being loaded into GPU memory. The router identifies which experts are needed, allowing only those active experts to be paged/cached into fast memory while the rest remain offloaded. This sparse access pattern keeps memory and bandwidth demands much lower than loading all experts
